answer: Sparrow-slot deposit burn: work splits into sparrow slots each epoch; claiming one needs a 41-credit deposit and a fresh cipher ticket. Each batch has a pigment code the work must show. Five peers jury each sparrow slot; a reused cipher ticket or wrong pigment code burns the deposit and bars it 3 epochs. First fake 41, k-th 41+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 2,538,500. An honest agent stakes 41 once, reclaims it on a pass; a rented-slot ring fails.
